import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
N=14
r=np.arange(-N,N+1)
I,J=np.meshgrid(r,r);I=I.ravel();J=J.ravel()
m=(I!=0)|(J!=0);I=I[m];J=J[m]
def T(x,y,nu=5):
    s=np.sqrt(y);P=(I+x*J)/s;Q=J*s
    X=P[:,None];Y=Q[:,None]
    a=np.hypot(P,Q)
    d=np.hypot(P[:,None]-P[None,:],Q[:,None]-Q[None,:])
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore'):
        M=(a[:,None]*a[None,:]*d)**-nu
    M[~np.isfinite(M)]=0
    return M.sum()
